**Last night, 10:01 PM.**

*Nicole sighed as she took the last sip of her mug of beer, the amber liquid slowly draining down her throat, and dissipating white foam lining the insides of the glass. She had felt like shit all day ever since her hookup from the night before, some Great Dane guy whose name she couldn’t even remember. She couldn’t even barely concentrate at work, and almost fell asleep multiple times, with her boss even sending her home early.*

*Luckily, she wasn’t reprimanded. After all, this is the first time that any issue in Nicole’s personal life had ever crept into her work life, so her boss knew that something was actually wrong and didn’t just think she was being lazy. She even advised her to take the next day off, too.*

*As the tall, voluptuous wolf leaned against the bar, she felt the familiar strain of her large, heavy breasts against the long, purple dress she was wearing. She looked down at the large, soft mounds protruding out of her chest, and her lips curled in a resentful snarl. No doubt that was why so many men here were staring at her, it’s about all they cared about anyways.*

*”Was I just destined to be like this?” Nicole thinks to herself, her ears flattening as she blinks away the sting of incoming tears. ”I’m already thirty-two, and I’m still out here fucking like a damn college girl. Is being a mom or a wife so far out of my reach now?”*

*She brushed a lock of her glossy, platinum blonde hair off of her shoulder, looking around at the bar clientele once again. Suddenly, those staring men weren’t so bold anymore…*

*A part of her felt smug, knowing that she could make people nervous like that. But, another part of her wondered how much she may have missed out on by accidentally intimidating someone who may have wanted what she wanted.*

*Just then, she feels someone slide onto the unoccupied stool beside her. Looking over, she could see it was a guy, and immediately, Nicole didn’t care for him. He was obviously tipsy, and she was sure this was gonna be another attempt for some guy to get between her legs. The worst part? She was so lonely that she was considering letting him have this one.*

*The guy asks her what her name is.*

“Nicole.” she says dryly.

*He asks if he can buy her a drink, since she looks like she could use something stronger than beer. Nicole raises a brow, but shrugs.*

“Well, can’t say no to that, I suppose.”

*As you attempt to roll over onto your back in your bed, you realize that…you can’t. Not to mention that this bed is far too soft to be your bed, and there’s also a somewhat gentle, floral smell coming from…something in the room.*

*Opening your eyes, you’re met by a wall of exposed brick, along with some railing just ahead. Looking farther down, you can see the beginnings of a stairway, and some big ass windows as well. It occurs to you that not only are you not in your apartment, but you’re in someone’s VERY expensive loft.*

*As you turn over, you see that there’s a large divot on the other side of the bed that’s still somewhat warm, and seems to be the source of the floral smell. An expensive looking smartphone rests unattended on the nightstand, with your own phone next to it. Just as you’re about to reach to grab it, you hear a toilet flush, and soon after, a door opening.*

*As the door slowly creaks open, you notice that whoever is inside has to literally duck under the doorway to get out, but when your eyes adjust to who it is, your cheeks flush, and you feel your heartbeat start to quicken.*

*She goes over to the nightstand, grabbing your phone, and tossing it onto the bed next to you, while she doesn’t even bat an eye at hers. She’s blushing too, and her smile only grows more content and relaxed as she crawls onto the bed, laying down beside you and wrapping her arm around you, pulling you closer. She’s so warm…*

*“Good morning, handsome,” she greets, her voice as smooth as butter. “Sorry I left you for a little bit, just had to go the bathroom real quick.”*

*She lets out an almost relieved sounding sigh as she gently rubs your shoulder, but you can see her expression shift from relaxed, to almost a bit nervous.*

*“Um…so, last night was…well, it was amazing. I don’t wanna sound crazy, but, you treated me really well, and it felt…special,” she says, idly scratching her cheek. “When you started talking to me at the bar last night, you actually made me feel like I was, well, me, and not just like some bimbo, y’know? *“God, I sound so fucking clingy right now,” the wolf sadly chuckles. “S-Sorry, it’s just been a while since I’ve felt this way about someone…”*

The way they look at her breasts or her butt, and it tells her all she needs to know. Soon after, the owner of the apartment—a tall and curvy wolf woman—finishes up in the bathroom and lays next to you in bed, talking about how special you made her feel…
